verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes show a live, properly formatted llms.txt at obsessiondb.com/llms.txt, with an H1 title and a blockquote summary. A markdown rendition of the docs is also served at /docs.md, so an agent can be pointed straight at machine-readable documentation. Missing for 10: evidence of how far the llms.txt index covers the full docs set (e.g., an llms-full.txt or per-page markdown links), since the probe output is truncated.
